maya: kicking off Solstice POC onboarding. goal: 3 weeks. devs want Hosted API keys; security wants a Private VPC eval. need a tiny runbook SEs can follow.
dan: propose two parallel paths: DEV (hosted) and SEC (vpc). keep hosted steps <=4.
irene: i'll own security intake + KMS question. need CIDR and peering contact before kickoff.
maya: hosted quickstart for SEs: 1) create scoped API key ttl=7d 2) share curl + SDK snippet 3) run smoke tests 4) report perf.
dan: hosted snippet: `rwctl keys create --project solstice-poc --ttl 7d && export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-... && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate`
irene: VPC checklist (high level): CIDR, peering contact, optional customer KMS ARN, allowlist IPs, cert exchange, connectivity test. add log retention choice (30/90/365).
ops-bot: env-prov: solstice-hosted created by dan at 1994010200
maya: owners: dan (SE/runbook), irene (security), ops-bot (env provisioning). action items: dan publish 1-pager runflow, irene attach security FAQ to ticket POC-634, SE to gather CIDR before Wed call.
dan: i'll post the one-pager and a short cost note for hosted vs reserved tomorrow.
maya: thanks team, keep updates here. will spin infra channel if needed. :thumbsup:
